gloss: to take one's leave; to resign; to decline

definitions.gloss: to take one's leave (of a place)
definitions.explanation: To leave a place where one has been visiting, especially politely after a formal call.

definitions.gloss: to resign (from a post); to decline
definitions.explanation: To step down from a position, or to turn down something offered. Often in the pattern 〜も{辞|じ}さない (to be ready to go as far as).

examples.japanese: ⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{辞|じ}する。
examples.english: To take one's leave of the room.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{遅|おそ}い→遅い：00533_osoi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦そろそろ→そろそろ：01259_sorosoro⟧{辞|じ}することにした。
examples.english: Since it was late, I decided it was time to take my leave.

examples.japanese: ⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{礼|れい}→礼：02170_rei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{述|の}べて→述べる：02389_noberu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{辞|じ}した。
examples.english: The guest thanked the president politely and then left his house.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{責任|せきにん}→責任：03298_sekinin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}って→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦{大臣|だいじん}→大臣：03417_daijin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{辞|じ}した。
examples.english: He took responsibility and resigned as minister.

examples.japanese: ⟦{組合|くみあい}→組合：02669_kumiai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ストライキ⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{辞|じ}さない{構|かま}えだ。
examples.english: The union is prepared to go as far as a strike.

notes:
A formal written verb. The conversational equivalents are ⟦{帰|かえ}る→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧ or ⟦{失礼|しつれい}する→失礼する：15203_shitsureisuru⟧ (to leave) and {辞|や}める (to resign). {辞|じ}す is an older form used the same way.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{職|しょく}→職：00376_shoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{辞|じ}する: to resign one's post
- 〜⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{辞|じ}さない: to be ready to go as far as ~ (⟦{戦|たたか}い→戦い：02070_tatakai⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{辞|じ}さない, prepared even to fight)
- {辞|じ}する⟦{間際|まぎわ}→間際：14564_magiwa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: just as (one) was leaving

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{辞任|じにん}→辞任：10144_jinin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to resign — the standard word in news for officials stepping down
- ⟦{辞退|じたい}する→辞退する：18992_jitaisuru⟧: to decline (an offer, a prize)

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: transitive
- Pattern: 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{辞|じ}する
